# Ruckig vendored source

Upstream: https://github.com/pantor/ruckig
Version: v0.15.3
Commit: 37b6e7a4c60f5befd2506741d5f7d0ae7eefb3db
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

The upstream source is unmodified. AVIATOR builds the C++ library locally,
with cloud client, Python, upstream examples and tests disabled. No network
access or downloaded dependencies are required at build/run time.
